note_records.text: **2026-10-15** — Profiles can declare fonts (profile and per-variant lists); PDF builds check them with fc-list --format (unescaped families, case-insensitive) once per call during planning and fail with 'profile <config> needs font "X", which is not installed' before anything is written, naming the config that selected the profile (directory name for path-selected or pinned profiles). items.title: Render TeX math without a browser or network
items.short_title: Render TeX math without a browser or network

note_records.text: **2026-10-15** — Owner decisions 2026-10-15: approved mathjax@4.1.3 (Apache-2.0, plain 'mathjax' package; mathjax-full is deprecated) as an optional npm dependency, installed by a separate --with-math installer flag (not folded into --with-mermaid; no browser needed). Scratch evaluation: TeX->SVG in Node works offline, ~40ms. Use svg {fontCache: 'local', linebreaks: {inline: false}} - default inline linebreaking splits into multiple SVGs and WeasyPrint shows only the first. Use tex formatError that throws and remove 'noundefined' so undefined macros error. Output has role=img and data-latex but no aria-label/title; add the TeX source as accessible text. mhchem needs an extra font package (out of scope).

**2026-10-20** — Verified: TeX math renders as MathJax 4.1.3 inline SVG (math/ runtime via install.py --with-math, no browser); cached by TeX, display, MathJax+font version and worker hash; fresh TeX components per expression and in-math definers rejected so cached results cannot depend on batch order; --no-math byte-identical to prior output; HTML without runtime keeps MathML with a warning, PDF errors with install hint; TeX errors name file and expression. 157 unit and 23 integration tests OK on s12 merged with main; real PDF builds inspected. Gate VERDICT: PASS.

items.short_title: Check for the Mermaid renderer before building starts

note_records.text: **2026-10-14** — Mermaid renderer is checked after planning and before any render: a fence in any job's Markdown or applicable includes with the renderer missing fails the call with the install hint naming file and line, and nothing is written. Skips --no-mermaid, inapplicable includes, and top-level indented code. 80 tests green; gate PASS; real PDF run checked (missing renderer: rc=1, no PDFs; --no-mermaid: both PDFs). Known low gaps: indented fences under ~ definition lists, containers inside blockquotes, '> <tab>' fences and indented footnote labels are treated as indented code, so they fall back to the render-time error.

goals:
- G1 Safe builds: a build never destroys input, and a failed build leaves the existing output intact.
- G2 Reliable runtime: PDF builds work with the venv or a PATH WeasyPrint, and installer flags do what they say.
- G3 Profile management from the CLI: setting a default or removing a profile needs no hand-editing of config.toml.
- G4 Batch builds: build several documents in one call.
- G5 branded-pdf parity: quire does everything branded-pdf does (verbatim text, math, page breaks, per-build overrides, loud font failures), so branded-pdf can become a thin wrapper around it.
non_goals: - Pandoc option passthrough and watch mode are out of scope for this roadmap. Windows support is deferred (see its later item), not excluded.
